label: Zoho CRM
description: Search and update leads, contacts, accounts, deals, and activities in one Zoho CRM account.
securityDescription: Zoho CRM sign-in opens through Composio, which also asks for the account's data center region. Agents act as the signed-in Zoho user and read leads, contacts, accounts, deals, calls, events, tasks, notes, products, record emails, timelines, related records, and attachment lists. With write access, Agents can create contacts, leads, deals, events, and notes, update accounts and deals, and update up to 100 leads in one call. A new contact or lead can include its email address; workflow rules the organization set up can still email new records, as they do for records people create. Agents cannot delete or merge records, change a record's owner, add event participants, upload files, send or draft email, share notes with portal users, or change users, roles, fields, views, workflows, or web forms.

drop.ZOHO_ADD_TAGS_TO_RECORDS: Tags up to 500 records in one call; record writes here are one record at a time.
drop.ZOHO_CREATE_AUTOMATION_TASK: Changes CRM automation, which acts on other records later.
drop.ZOHO_CREATE_CUSTOM_FIELD: Changes the CRM schema for everyone.
drop.ZOHO_CREATE_CUSTOM_VIEW: Changes CRM view configuration; its access_type sets who sees the view.
drop.ZOHO_DOWNLOAD_RECORD_ATTACHMENT: Returns file bytes; attachment names and sizes stay readable through list_record_attachments.
drop.ZOHO_DOWNLOAD_RECORD_PHOTO: Returns image bytes of a profile photo, which carries no CRM information the Agent needs.
drop.ZOHO_GET_FROM_ADDRESSES: Lists sending addresses, which only matter to email tools this connector leaves out.
drop.ZOHO_GET_PROFILE: Permission profile; user and permission tools are out of scope.
drop.ZOHO_GET_USER: User and permission tools are out of scope; records carry their owner's name.
drop.ZOHO_GET_ZOHO_USERS: User and permission tools are out of scope; records carry their owner's name.
drop.ZOHO_LIST_ACCESS_SETTINGS: Roles and permission profiles; user and permission tools are out of scope.
drop.ZOHO_LIST_VARIABLES: Lists configuration variables with their current values, which can hold credentials.
drop.ZOHO_UPDATE_CUSTOM_VIEW: Changes CRM view configuration for everyone who uses the view.
drop.ZOHO_UPDATE_WEBFORM: Replaces a web form that outside visitors submit.
drop.ZOHO_UPDATE_WORKFLOW_RULE: Changes CRM automation, which acts on other records later.
drop.ZOHO_UPLOAD_ATTACHMENT: With the file argument withheld, only a deprecated URL field remains, which Zoho ignores, so the tool cannot attach anything.
drop.ZOHO_UPSERT_RECORDS: Writes up to 100 records and merges into existing ones by duplicate matching, so one call can overwrite records the Agent did not name.

capabilities.description: Retrieves related list metadata for a Zoho CRM module to discover correct api_name values. capabilities.description: Fetch related-list records (e.g., Notes, Attachments, Emails) for a Zoho CRM parent record using related_list_api_name. Use ZOHO_GET_RELATED_LISTS first to discover the correct api_name for the related list you want to access. Supports pagination for large result sets (up to 2,000 records with page/per_page and up to Zoho's token-pagination limit with page_token).

ids.description: Comma-separated list of specific related record IDs to retrieve. Use this to fetch only certain related records instead of all related records. When continuing with page_token, provide the same IDs used for the original request. Example: '4876876000000636001,4876876000000636002'

page.description: Page number to retrieve (default: 1). Without page_token, only the first 2,000 records are accessible using page/per_page pagination. Maximum page number is floor(2000/per_page). Do not use together with page_token.

fields.description: Comma-separated API names of the fields to retrieve (required by Zoho for this API). Specify the field names from the related list module whose details you want to receive. Example: 'Note_Title,Note_Content,Created_Time' for Notes. Field names vary by related list type - check module field definitions to ensure correct names.

sort_by.description: Valid fields for sorting related records.

per_page.description: Number of records per page (default and maximum: 200). Applies to both page and page_token pagination.

converted.description: Filter for converted status (applicable to certain related lists).

record_id.description: The unique identifier of the parent record for which to retrieve related records. This is the ID of the record in the specified module.

page_token.description: Token-based pagination parameter to fetch records beyond the 2,000-record discrete limit. Use the info.next_page_token from the previous response. Cannot be used together with page. Repeat the original fields, per_page, IDs, sort, and converted-filter values because Zoho binds the token to that query.

module_api_name.description: The API name of the parent module containing the record. Examples: 'Leads', 'Contacts', 'Accounts', 'Deals', 'Tasks', etc. This must be a valid module API name in Zoho CRM.

related_list_api_name.description: The API name of the related list to retrieve (e.g., 'Notes', 'Attachments', 'Emails'). IMPORTANT: Use the ZOHO_GET_RELATED_LISTS action first to discover the correct api_name for the related list you want to access. Using an incorrect api_name will result in INVALID_DATA errors. Example values: 'Notes', 'Attachments', 'Activities', 'Emails', 'Campaigns', 'Products', 'Open_Activities', 'Closed_Activities', 'Invited_Events'.

capabilities.description: Retrieves lead records from Zoho CRM's Leads module with pagination support. Use this action when you need to list, filter, or paginate through leads in the CRM. Supports both discrete pagination (up to 2,000 leads) and token-based pagination for larger datasets.

page_token.description: Token-based pagination parameter to fetch leads beyond the 2,000-record discrete limit. Use the info.next_page_token from the previous response. Cannot be used together with page.

capabilities.description: Retrieves tasks from the Tasks module in Zoho CRM with support for filtering, pagination, and sorting. Use this action when you need to fetch a page of tasks or specific tasks by IDs. Supports both discrete pagination (up to 2,000 tasks) and token-based pagination for larger datasets. Notes: - Discrete (page/per_page) pagination is limited to the first 2,000 tasks. To retrieve tasks beyond this, use token-based pagination via page_token from the previous response's info.next_page_token. - Do not use page together with page_token. - You cannot use cvid together with sort_by.

ids.description: Comma-separated task IDs to fetch specific tasks. When using page_token, this must match the original query.

cvid.description: Custom view ID to filter the tasks. Cannot be used together with sort_by. When using page_token, this must match the original query.

page.description: Page number to retrieve. Without page_token, only the first 2,000 tasks are accessible using page/per_page. Maximum page number is floor(2000/per_page). Do not use together with page_token.

sort_by.description: Valid fields for sorting Zoho CRM tasks.

per_page.description: Number of tasks per page (default 25, max 200). Applies to both page and page_token pagination.

page_token.description: Token-based pagination parameter to fetch tasks beyond the 2,000-record discrete limit. Use the info.next_page_token from the previous response. Cannot be used together with page.

capabilities.description: Updates an existing Account record in Zoho CRM with the specified field values. Only the fields provided in the request will be updated; other fields remain unchanged. Use this action when you need to modify specific details of an existing account, such as contact information, address, ownership, or business details. All field updates use API field names (not display labels), and lookup fields require properly formatted dictionaries with 'id' keys.
capabilities.sideEffectLabel: Zoho CRM: Update Zoho CRM Account

trigger.description: Automation triggers to execute during update.

capabilities.description: Updates an existing deal in Zoho CRM. Use this action when you need to modify specific fields of a deal record, such as updating the deal amount, stage, closing date, or associated account. Only the fields included in the data parameter will be modified; other fields remain unchanged. Use when you have a specific deal ID and want to update one or more fields without affecting others.
capabilities.sideEffectLabel: Zoho CRM: Update Zoho CRM Deal

Stage.description: Current stage of the deal (e.g., 'Qualification', 'Negotiation/Review', 'Closed Won')

Amount.description: Deal amount in the account's currency

Closing_Date.description: Expected closing date in YYYY-MM-DD format

data.description: Object containing the deal fields to update. Use field API names as keys (not display names). Common fields include: 'Deal_Name', 'Amount', 'Stage', 'Closing_Date', 'Account_Name' (as lookup: {'id': 'account_id'}), 'Contact_Name' (as lookup: {'id': 'contact_id'}), 'Owner' (as lookup: {'id': 'user_id'}). Only include fields you intend to modify — unintended fields will overwrite existing data. For lookup fields, use format: {'id': 'record_id'} or {'id': 'record_id', 'name': 'Display Name'}.

deal_id.description: The unique identifier of the deal to update. This is the Zoho CRM record ID.

trigger.description: List of automation triggers to execute during update. Valid values: ['workflow', 'approval', 'blueprint', 'pathfinder', 'orchestration']. Pass empty array [] to skip all automation. If not specified, default triggers execute. Example: ['workflow', 'blueprint']

Use this action when you need to modify lead information such as contact details, lead status, lead source, or other lead-specific fields. Use field API names (not display names) for all field updates. The 'id' field is mandatory for each lead.

withheldArguments.data[].Email: names an address a message goes to or comes from
withheldArguments.data[].Owner: changes sharing, visibility, permissions, membership, or who acts
withheldArguments.data[].Phone: changes who the record belongs to or how a person is identified
withheldArguments.data[].Mobile: changes who the record belongs to or how a person is identified
withheldArguments.data[].Lead_Source: copies content from another record, URL, or file

id.description: Unique identifier of the lead record to update

State.description: State or province of the lead

Zip_Code.description: Zip or postal code of the lead

Lead_Status.description: Current status of the lead (e.g., New, Contacted, Qualified)

items.description: Lead record data with common and custom fields.

data.description: A list of lead records to be updated. Each lead MUST include the 'id' field with the lead record ID to update. Update up to 100 leads per API call. Use field API names as keys (not display names). Common updatable fields: Last_Name, First_Name, Email, Phone, Mobile, Company, Lead_Source, Lead_Status, Industry, Rating, Street, City, State, Country, Zip_Code. For owner assignment, use the 'Owner' field with value {'id': '<zoho_user_id>'}; using email or display name will fail.

trigger.description: List of automation triggers to execute during update. Valid values: ['workflow', 'approval', 'blueprint', 'pathfinder', 'orchestration']. Pass empty array [] to skip all automation. If not specified, default triggers execute. Example: ['workflow', 'blueprint']
